objective.title: Your objective
objective.p1a: You have ventured into the dungeon to claim
objective.p1b: and never worry about being poor again. Easy, right?
objective.p2b: : 26 enemies, 9 weapons and 9 heals. To take all that wealth home you have to clear the
objective.p3a: Every round brings more enemies, some of them with
objective.p3b: . When you reach 0 health you lose; if you clear round 10, you win the run.

cards.title: Cards
cards.p1b: you play with the cards of a poker deck, where each one has its own role.
cards.p2b: are the spades and the clubs. Their base values run from 2 to 14, although in later rounds their damage can go up.
cards.p2d: are the hearts. Basic weapons and heals have values from 2 to 10.
cards.p3: Special cards worth 11 or more can be found in the shop and have their own effects.

tooltips.food: Food! It will heal you after the fight. Its base power runs from 2 to 10
tooltips.weapon: These are the weapons that will help you in the dungeon. Their base power runs from 2 to 10.
tooltips.humanoid: These are humanoid enemies. Their base value runs from 2 to 14.
tooltips.monster: These are monstrous enemies. Their base value runs from 2 to 14.

spade.description: Played against the active weapon. Its value sets the damage you take.

diamond.description: Placed in the equipment zone, it reduces the damage from enemies.

heart.description: Played to restore health. Special cards add other effects.

club.description: Clubs are monstrous enemies that follow the same combat rules.

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.p1a: During your run you will keep earning
modifiers.p1b: that will help you get as far as possible. At the start of every round you are offered
modifiers.p2a: You can also buy modifiers in the shop.

shop.title: Shop
shop.p1a: After every round ends, the shop appears where you can spend the gold you earned on
shop.p2b: as a base every time you defeat an enemy with your weapon. Some characters and modifiers can raise this reward.

antiheal.name: Heal Block
antiheal.description: For the rest of the hand, it stops you from healing.

dmg_reduction.name: Damage Reduction
dmg_reduction.description: Reduces the next attack you take by 10.

extra_gold.name: Extra Gold
extra_gold.description: The enemy hands you gold equal to its value.

heal_roulete.name: Healing Roulette
heal_roulete.description: Heals 100 health, but it has a 25% chance of doing the opposite.

invincibility.name: Invincibility
invincibility.description: The first attack you take with this weapon deals you 0 damage.

plunder.name: Plunder
plunder.description: The enemy takes gold equal to twice its value.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: It deals 1 damage when you cycle your hand, for 3 turns.

progresive_heal.name: Progressive Heal
progresive_heal.description: It heals 10 health and then 3 per round for 3 rounds.

restore_ability.name: Restore Ability
restore_ability.description: Restores your character's ability, but it does not heal you.

health_steal.name: Life Steal
health_steal.description: You steal 1 health from every enemy defeated with this weapon.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: If you were about to die while hitting with the weapon carrying the effect, you survive at 1 health.

mitosis.name: Mitosis
mitosis.description: When you kill the enemy, it creates two weaker enemies.

souleater.name: Soul Eater
souleater.description: For 3 turns, you lose 3 max health.

seal.name: Arcane Seal
seal.description: For 3 turns, your ability stays locked.

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.description: Even if you run away, the card stays in your hand.

simulator.guide: Pick a scenario or click the cards. The simulator will show you why the weapon is used or skipped.

explore.label: Explore
explore.description: Try every card available in the simulator.

first_weapon.label: First hit
first_weapon.description: Place a weapon and try its first use against an enemy.

strict_order.label: Combat order
strict_order.description: Check when the weapon can be applied again.

without_weapon.label: No weapon
without_weapon.description: See how much damage you take with no active weapon.

special_cards.label: Special cards
special_cards.description: Try the shop cards worth 11, 12 and 13.

poison.label: Poison

weapon_breaker.label: Weapon Breaker

plunder.label: Plunder

extra_gold.label: Extra Gold

souleater.label: Soul Eater
souleater.description: You lose 3 max health for 3 turns.

antiheal.label: Heal Block
antiheal.description: You cannot heal for the rest of the hand.

mitosis.label: Mitosis
mitosis.description: Defeating the enemy spawns two weaker enemies.

seal.label: Arcane Seal
seal.description: Your ability is locked for 3 turns.

blocked.label: Blocked

minibosses.title: Minibosses
minibosses.intro: Minibosses show up at specific moments of a run and follow their own rules. They do not behave like a normal card: read their effect before deciding how to face them.

reina_slime.name: Slime Queen
reina_slime.description: Halves its value and creates two weaker slimes. The Slime Queen is defeated once it drops to value 2.

arana_gigante.name: Giant Spider
arana_gigante.description: The Spider is split into parts. When you clear a part, you cannot flee for 3 turns.

chaman_demoniaco.name: Demonic Shaman
chaman_demoniaco.description: Its value changes with the enemies left. If you hit it, it is removed immediately, but it can show up again.

reina_ladrones.name: Queen of Thieves
reina_ladrones.description: When you defeat her, she steals 25% of your gold and destroys the weapon you used to beat her.

rey_hada.name: Fairy King
rey_hada.description: Every time you heal, the Fairy King cuts your max health by 2, down to a minimum of 2.

guantes.name: Gloves
guantes.description: Every time you flee, Gloves adds a hair ball card worth 0 with a random effect.

bola_pelo.name: Hair Ball
bola_pelo.description: It is not a standalone miniboss: it is a card summoned by Gloves that can call its owner back.

mimico.name: Mimic
mimico.description: It poses as a heal, but its real value is 16. You will have to compare its clues to uncover it.

strategies.guerrero: At half health or less, it deals 50% more damage and can make enemies flee.
strategies.paladin: Starts with 25 max health. It recovers 5 health each round.
strategies.elfo: Lowers the value of two cards and can flee one extra time.
strategies.mago: Can see information about the next cards and shuffle the deck.
strategies.apostador: Gets 50 gold at the start and gains 10 base gold per enemy defeated with a weapon.
strategies.herrero: Gains 1 extra damage with weapons and can forge a weapon during the round.
strategies.vampiro: Steals health when defeating enemies, up to a maximum of 10.
strategies.domador: Gains 1 extra damage with weapons and can turn enemies into weapons.
